1.kind: Missing sentence-level wrapper: sentences not grouped under snt1/snt2 of a top-level and
1.cause: Annotator merged the two sentences into one flat 'and' graph with four conjuncts instead of separate snt1 and snt2 conjunctions under a document-level 'and'. This yields an extra 'and' as the root, treated as extra mod.
1.convention: Each sentence of a multi-sentence input is its own sub-graph (snt1, snt2) joined under a top-level and; clauses within a sentence are conjoined within that sentence's own and.

1.kind: Compound noun 山泥 split into 泥 with mod 山 instead of kept as a single concept
1.cause: Annotator decomposed the lexicalized compound 山泥 (landslide mud) into head and modifier rather than treating it as one word.
1.convention: Lexicalized compound nouns are kept as a single concept rather than decomposed into head plus modifier.

1.kind: Wrong aspect on 水浸 and 倾泻 (performance instead of process)
1.cause: Annotator marked the flooding and landslide events as performance, but gold treats them as ongoing processes inside the 出现 event.
1.convention: Ongoing/unbounded events (e.g., flooding, landslides occurring) get aspect process rather than performance.

1.kind: Wrong core role on 浸-01 theme (ARG1 instead of ARG2)
1.cause: Annotator used ARG1 for 水 with 浸-01; the frame/gold uses ARG2 for the thing flooded or the water.
1.convention: Core argument labels follow the PropBank/frameset roleset of the predicate.

1.kind: Wrong role for the rate-entity time unit (ARG3 instead of ARG2)
1.cause: Annotator put the temporal-quantity in ARG3 of rate-entity-91; the gold puts it in ARG2 (the per-unit denominator).
1.convention: In rate-entity-91, ARG1 is the quantity and ARG2 is the per-unit (time) quantity; ARG3 is not used for it.

1.kind: Temporal relations wrong: all events anchored to DCT instead of the gold relations among events (sequence)
1.cause: Annotator related each main event directly to document-creation-time with :before, while gold anchors only the first event (重创) to DCT and relates 出现 as overlap with it and 启动/形容 as being :after relative to 重创 events. Gold's relations for the later events are a little unusual (the :after direction), but the annotator did not chain events.
1.convention: Only the first event is anchored to DCT; subsequent events in the narrative are related to earlier events (overlap for co-occurring, after for subsequent) rather than each directly to DCT.

1.kind: Generic/habitual event 遇 anchored to document-creation-time instead of present-reference
1.cause: Annotator used document-creation-time :overlap for the habitual 'once in 500 years' event; gold uses present-reference.
1.convention: Generic or habitual states/events that hold at the present are anchored with present-reference :overlap, not document-creation-time.

1.kind: Coreference chains over-linked or incomplete across the document (cities, 暴雨, 遇, 政府/当局, 雨势, 启动, 情况)
1.cause: Annotator created spurious chains (repeated 暴雨, 遇-01, 浸-01 mentions, 政府/当局 and names) and missed other links (机构, 雨势 in later sentences, 启动, 情况/状况). Annotator also wrongly chained 当地 with the cities.
1.convention: Coreference chains are linked only for clearly identical referents, covering repeated mentions of same entity or event across sentences, while generic repeats of event-type nouns are not chained.

2.kind: Wrong relation concept for coordination: 'and' instead of 'and-91'
2.cause: Annotator used the generic English 'and' for clause coordination instead of the UMR coordination predicate and-91.
2.convention: Coordination of events/clauses is annotated with the and-91 predicate (not plain 'and'); the nominal coordination in the gold is also 'and' without sense.

2.kind: Storm name annotated as a separate 'storm' entity with ARG0 of 残留 rather than natural-disaster with identity-91 to 风暴; 云带 is not ARG1 of 残留 and the name is attached differently
2.check: a_event_concept, a_entity_concept, d_core_args_event, d_core_args_abstract, d_peripheral_entity, e_core_labels, f_name_tokens
2.cause: Annotator treated 风暴 as the named entity itself (with name 海葵) and made it ARG0 of 残留-01 with 云带 as ARG1. Gold treats 云带 as the ARG0 (agent-like theme) of 残留, with 云带 part-of a named natural-disaster 海葵 that is identical to the common noun 风暴 via identity-91. The annotator also wrongly used 'name' as the concept in the identity position.
2.convention: A named entity whose category is a known type (e.g. natural-disaster) is given that type concept with a name; a common-noun description of the same entity is linked via identity-91 (ARG1 the named entity, ARG2 the noun). Part-whole relations ('X's remnant cloud band') use :part-of from the part to the whole. Intransitive stative/resultative 残留 takes the participant as ARG0 (ARG0-of in a relative clause).

2.cause: Annotator assigned an aspect to the modifier event 残留 in a relative clause, which gold leaves unmarked.
2.convention: Event modifiers inside a nominal (relative clause) are not given an aspect value in the gold.

2.kind: Extra :ARG1 s2r on 影响-01 (reentrancy of the affected region)
2.cause: Annotator added an affected-entity argument to 影响 that the gold omits (the gold only has ARG0).
2.convention: Arguments that are not explicitly expressed in the clause are not added; in the gold 影响-01 has only the overt ARG0.

2.kind: 区 with 各 as separate modifier instead of the lexicalized concept 各区
2.cause: Annotator split 各区 into 区 plus :mod 各, whereas gold keeps 各区 as a single concept.
2.convention: Quantifying determiner + noun compounds such as 各区 are kept as one concept rather than splitting off the quantifier.

2.kind: Station annotated as unmodified 'station' vs 站 concept; name tokens differ (黄大仙 vs 黄大仙 站); MTR as company with name instead of plain concept 港铁; part-of attached to the individual conjuncts rather than the conjunction
2.cause: Annotator used the Chinese word 站 as the concept and put 黄大仙 alone as the name, and treated 港铁 as a named company. Gold uses English 'station' with name 黄大仙 站 and keeps 港铁 as a plain concept (part-of the station) and puts part-of on the 'and' node for 大堂 and 月台.
2.convention: Known entity types get English type concepts (station) and names include the full name tokens as written; the shared part-of is attached to the coordination node as a whole.

2.kind: Wrong temporal structure: date-entity rather than events anchored to the DCT; 涌入 related to DCT instead of overlapping 降
2.cause: Annotator anchored the date-entity to the DCT and chained the events off it, and placed 涌入 as before DCT; gold relates 残留 to DCT, 降 overlaps 残留, 影响, 起 and 涌入.
2.convention: Temporal expressions (起) are linked by :overlap to their event; coordinated co-occurring events overlap each other; DCT :before is placed on the earliest/background event (残留).

2.kind: Extra modal full-affirmative on 残留-01
2.cause: Annotator gave a modal annotation to the relative-clause event, which gold does not.

2.kind: Coreference: wrong/missing chains (香港 city chain incomplete, 港铁 wrongly linked, 暴雨 chain extra)
2.cause: Annotator linked 暴雨 repeatedly as same-entity across sentences whereas gold does not; it missed some city mentions and chain links for 云带 and gold links 云带 to an earlier mention.
2.convention: Generic repeated event nouns are not necessarily coreferent; coreference is annotated for specific entities repeated across sentences.

3.kind: Wrong root concept for coordination: 'and' instead of 'and-91'
3.cause: The annotator used the generic 'and' for the sentence-level coordination of clauses; the gold uses the 'and-91' predicate for this relation.
3.convention: Coordination of clauses/events at the sentence level is annotated with the and-91 predicate, while 'and' is used for coordinating entities inside an argument.

3.kind: Wrong argument roles for the 邻近 predicate (ARG1-of/ARG2 instead of ARG0-of/ARG1)
3.cause: The annotator treated the building as ARG1 of 邻近-01 and the station as ARG2; the gold treats the building as ARG0 (the one adjoining) with the station as ARG1.
3.convention: For 邻近-01 'adjacent to', the entity that is near is ARG0 and the reference location is ARG1. Roles follow the frameset.

3.kind: Wrong aspect and roles in 浸泡-01 (ARG0 洪水 vs ARG2; aspect activity vs state)
3.cause: The annotator labeled the flood as ARG0 with ARG1 the escalator and aspect activity; the gold uses ARG2 for the flood (the soaking medium) and treats the ongoing situation as state.
3.convention: In the 浸泡 frame the soaking liquid is ARG2 and the soaked thing is ARG1. A resultant-state/ongoing 着-marked predicate is annotated with aspect state.

3.kind: Wrong aspect and extra ARG1 reentrancy for 漂浮-01 (activity vs state)
3.cause: The annotator marked the 着-marked floating as activity and added a reentrant ARG1 to the flood; the gold uses state and has no such argument.
3.convention: Predicates marked with durative 着 describing a resulting/ongoing state take aspect state, and unexpressed participants are not added as arguments.

3.kind: Wrong predicate and argument order for 等-enumeration (have-example-91 vs include-91; ARG roles swapped)
3.cause: The annotator used have-example-91 with the set as ARG2 of the item (ARG1-of), whereas the gold uses include-91 with 杂物 as ARG2-of and the listed members as ARG1.
3.convention: Exemplification with 等 'etc.' is annotated with include-91, where the member list is ARG1 and the whole category is ARG2.

3.kind: List members split incorrectly: 桌 and 椅 split, 等 not represented
3.cause: The annotator split the compound 桌椅 into 桌 and 椅 coordinated entities and dropped 等; the gold keeps 桌椅 as a single concept and 等 as a separate member.
3.convention: Lexicalized compounds like 桌椅 stay as a single concept, and 等 is kept as a concept in the list.

3.kind: Compound noun 重灾区 split into 重 and 灾区 with extra :mod
3.cause: The annotator segmented the compound word 重灾区 into a modifier 重 and the head 灾区; the gold keeps it as a single concept.
3.convention: Words that are single lexical items/compounds in the source are kept as a single concept rather than decomposed into modifier + head.

3.kind: Document-creation-time temporal relations wrongly added and chain relations wrong
3.cause: The annotator anchored the events 浸泡 and 漂浮 to the document creation time (:before) and added DCT :overlap for the state clauses; the gold chains the events with :overlap from 淹没 to 浸泡 to 漂浮 and does not link the states to DCT.
3.convention: Coordinated events in the same scene are linked to each other by :overlap rather than individually to DCT, and state-like descriptions are not given extra DCT relations.

3.kind: Date-entity relation to 淹没 :overlap instead of :contained
3.cause: The annotator related the date to the event with :overlap; the gold uses :contained since the event occurred within the day.
3.convention: An event located on a specific day is :contained in that date-entity.

3.kind: Inter-sentence temporal link: previous sentence's event and this date
3.cause: The annotator linked the previous date-entity :before the current date; the gold links the previous sentence's event 涌入 :after the current date.

4.kind: Coordination of nouns structured wrongly: annotator made 'and' the argument with 服务 duplicated per conjunct; gold uses single 服务-01 event with a nested and of 巴士/电车
4.cause: Annotator distributed 服务 over each conjunct (服务 with :mod 巴士 / 电车) and used a bare 服务 noun instead of treating 服务 as an event 服务-01 with the coordinated modifiers
4.convention: Light nouns like 服务 that head a coordinated modifier phrase are annotated as a single predicate (服务-01) whose modifier is the coordination of the modifiers; do not duplicate the head

4.kind: Wrong sense/label for top-level coordination: 'and' instead of 'and-91'
4.cause: Annotator used generic 'and' for clause-level coordination of events rather than the and-91 form
4.convention: Coordination of events/clauses at the sentence level is annotated with and-91

4.kind: Wrong roleset sense for 恢复 (恢复-02 vs 恢复-01) and wrong argument structure (ARG1 shared and :temporal s4dt instead of ARG0 and temporal 直至 with 下午)
4.cause: Annotator picked a different PropBank sense and reentered the date-entity as a shared temporal rather than giving 恢复 its own 直至 temporal

4.kind: 直至 temporal attached to 暂停 instead of 恢复, with 下午 wrapped in date-entity
4.cause: Annotator attached the 直至 clause to the first event and wrapped the day period in a date-entity; gold attaches it to 恢复 and uses 下午 as a bare concept
4.convention: Time words like 下午 are kept as simple concepts rather than date-entity; 直至 clause modifies the following verb 恢复

4.kind: Adverb 都 missed as :mod on 暂停-01
4.convention: Adverbs such as 都 are kept as :mod concepts on the predicate

4.kind: Quantity 数 treated as concept with :quant instead of a string value; 多 likewise treated as concept with :mod instead of :quant string
4.cause: Annotator made vague quantity words into concepts (数 as node, 多 as :mod) rather than quantity string values
4.convention: Vague quantity words (数, 多) are annotated as :quant with a string value

4.kind: 几乎 labeled :degree instead of :mod, and 所有 labeled :mod instead of :quant, and placement under 'and'
4.cause: Annotator used :degree for the adverb and :mod for the quantifier; gold uses :quant for 所有 with :mod 几乎, attached under the coordination
4.convention: Universal quantifiers such as 所有 are :quant; modifying adverbs of quantifiers are :mod

4.kind: Organization 港铁 annotated as company with name instead of a plain concept; 站点 made an ARG0 of 需要 with part-of instead of ARG1 of 关闭 with :part-of 港铁
4.cause: Annotator over-applied named entity structure and a control analysis (站点 as ARG0 of 需要), whereas gold treats 需要 as taking 关闭 as sole argument with 站点 as ARG1 of 关闭 and 港铁 as a direct concept
4.convention: Passive/modal 需要 takes the embedded event as its only argument; the patient belongs to the embedded event. Known organization names may be bare concepts without a name node

4.kind: Coreference of 港铁 missed because of different entity structure; city coref chain incomplete
4.cause: Because 港铁 was a company/name node the coref link did not align with the gold node; the annotator also missed later mentions of the city (snt6, snt12)
4.convention: Repeated mentions of the same entity across the document are linked with same-entity

4.kind: Temporal relations: events anchored to document-creation-time :before instead of gold ordering (需要 after 恢复, DCT overlap 服务)
4.cause: Annotator defaulted every event to DCT :before and omitted the relative ordering between events and the overlap of the 服务 entity
4.convention: Events following 直至 are ordered relative to the preceding event (:after); ongoing states overlap the DCT

5.kind: Organization name not annotated as a named entity (天文台 treated as identity-91 with 机构 instead of name)
5.cause: Annotator did not recognize 天文台 as the name of the organization and omitted it. It treated the appositive 机构 as a separate identity-91 concept, creating an extra entity and an extra abstract relation.
5.convention: A named entity is represented as a typed concept with a :name node containing the name tokens. Common nouns in an apposition or modifier role are not reified as identity-91 unless the gold does so.

5.kind: Nickname 黑雨 not annotated as a named natural-disaster entity; annotator used a common-noun 雨 with 黑 modifier
5.cause: Annotator treated the quoted 黑雨 as a regular noun with a modifier, splitting it into 雨 and 黑. The gold treats the quoted term as a name for a natural-disaster. As a result ARG1 of 维持 pointed to the wrong node.
5.convention: Quoted terms or nicknames naming a specific entity are annotated as a typed concept (e.g., natural-disaster) with a :name node, not decomposed into modifier and head.

5.kind: Duration 超过 16 小时 annotated as more-than quantity wrapper instead of event 超过-01 with ARG1 temporal-quantity; 一共 added as mod
5.check: a_event_concept; a_entity_found; d_core_args_event; d_peripheral_entity; c_aspect; i_modal; h_temporal
5.cause: Annotator used the English-style more-than abstraction instead of the language-specific predicate 超过-01. As a result the aspect state, the modal relation and the temporal overlap for 超过 were missing. 一共 was also added as a mod of the quantity, though the gold omits it.
5.convention: Chinese predicates like 超过 are annotated as their own events (超过-01) with the quantity as ARG1, and carry aspect state, a modal relation and temporal relations. Adverbs like 一共 are not added as separate modifiers.

5.kind: Wrong aspect for 维持-01 (activity instead of state)
5.cause: Annotator treated 维持 (maintain/last) as an ongoing activity, whereas the gold considers it a state.
5.convention: Predicates of lasting or maintaining a state over a duration take aspect state.

5.kind: Structure of coordinated color signals: annotator coordinated 信号 nodes, each with its own mod; gold has one 信号 with mods 警告, 暴雨 and an and of colors
5.cause: Annotator distributed the head noun 信号 across each conjunct and hung 警告 and 暴雨 on the and-node. Gold keeps a single 信号 with the colors coordinated as modifiers. The coordination was therefore ARG1 of 发出 rather than 信号, and the conjunct labels differed.
5.convention: When coordinated modifiers share one head noun, annotate the head once and coordinate the modifiers under :mod, rather than duplicating the head.

5.kind: Highest-level clause (最高级别的黑色) attached as modifiers of 信号 with 级别 as mod; gold uses identity-91 on 黑色 with ARG2 级别
5.cause: Annotator attached 级别 as a plain :mod of 信号 instead of expressing the equivalence of 黑色 with the highest level through identity-91.
5.convention: A modifier phrase like 'X of the highest level' is expressed with identity-91 where ARG1 is the modified item and ARG2 is the level noun (with have-degree-91).

5.kind: Temporal relation of 维持 to 内 event: annotator gave DCT before, gold gives overlap with 内 and 超过 overlap with 维持
5.cause: Annotator related 维持 only to the document creation time. It did not link it to the preceding event of the same sentence as overlapping, and it lacked a 超过 event.
5.convention: A clause coordinated with a preceding event in the same time frame is linked to it by :overlap; the duration event overlaps the event it measures.

5.kind: Coreference chain for the organization (later-sentence mention) is wrong
5.cause: Because the organization was not annotated as a name node, the coreference chain in later sentences pointed to organization rather than to the name node.
5.convention: Coreference to a named entity targets the entity concept that carries the name, consistently across sentences.

6.kind: Wrong concept for 无需: annotator used 需要-01 with polarity - instead of the lexicalized predicate 无需-01
6.cause: Annotator decomposed the negated word 无需 into 需要 plus negation instead of keeping the lexical item as the event concept. This also turned the modal into full-negative rather than full-affirmative and moved the temporal relation.
6.convention: Keep a negative lexicalized verb as a single predicate (no polarity attribute); the author is full-affirmative toward it.

6.kind: Argument structure of 无需: 上班族 was made ARG0 of 无需 and ARG1 an event, but gold has only the 上班 event as ARG1 with 上班族 as the ARG0 of 上班. Aspect of 上班 is state in gold, process in annotator's.
6.cause: Annotator treated 无需 as a control verb (需要 with a subject) and chose process aspect for 上班.
6.convention: 无需 takes the embedded event as its sole core argument; the subject belongs to the embedded event.

6.kind: Missing causal structure: 停课 and 无需上班 should be grouped as an 'and' that is the :cause-of 启动. The annotator made them flat siblings under the top 'and'. Consequently the temporal relations (启动 :after 停课/无需) are replaced by DCT :before.
6.cause: Annotator did not infer the implicit causal/consequence relation between the emergency declaration and the school closure and work suspension, and treated the clauses as coordinated.
6.convention: Clauses that follow from an event (consequences of an announced measure) are linked with :cause-of on that event, and the consequence events are temporally :after it.

6.kind: Wrong handling of 全港: annotator built a city named 港 with 全 as a mod on 学校; gold uses 港 as a plain concept (place) with 全 as its mod.
6.cause: Annotator interpreted 港 (Hong Kong abbreviation) as a named entity, whereas the gold keeps it as a common concept modified by 全.
6.convention: Abbreviated place words like 港 in 全港 are kept as a plain concept with :mod 全, not turned into a named entity.

6.kind: Organization 医管局 modeled as organization with mod 公立/医疗, whereas gold uses government-organization with identity-91 to 机构 carrying the modifiers (apposition 公立医疗机构 = 医管局).
6.cause: Annotator did not recognize the apposition between the descriptive noun phrase and the named organization, and used the generic organization type.
6.convention: Apposition between a descriptive noun phrase and a name is represented with identity-91; modifiers go on the descriptive noun; government bodies get government-organization.

6.kind: 送院 should be a single lexicalized predicate (送院-00), and the 受伤 and 送院 events should be grouped in a 'consecutive' structure; the annotator split it into 送 plus 院 and joined all in a flat 'and'. Also the 'and' scope differs (temporal attached to the 'and').
6.cause: Annotator split the compound verb-object 送院 and did not see the sequential relation of injury then being sent to hospital.
6.convention: Verb-object compounds that behave as one lexical verb are kept as one predicate; sequential events are marked with consecutive and temporally ordered.

6.kind: Person concept: gold uses the word 人 as the concept (110人, 4人), annotator used the abstract 'person'.
6.cause: Annotator replaced the Chinese noun 人 with the English abstract concept person.
6.convention: Use the surface Chinese noun as the concept when the word is present in text.

6.kind: Role of 暴雨 and the date-entity: gold has 暴雨 as :temporal on 受伤 and the date-entity as :temporal of the 'and' clause; annotator labeled 暴雨 :cause and put the date-entity under 受伤.
6.cause: Annotator interpreted 在暴雨中 causally; gold treats it as a temporal setting, and the time expression scopes over the whole reported content.
6.convention: 在…中 with a weather event is a temporal setting; a time expression scoping over a coordinated report is attached to the coordination.

6.kind: Ordinal-entity/initial 又 and annotator had :aspect after :ord; also the 'ord' modeling is the same, but extra arg2 consecutive appears. No substantive divergence beyond structure.
6.cause: Side effect of the consecutive/and structure mismatch.

6.kind: Temporal relations for the reporting event and date: gold has 指 :before the date-entity (and date contains injury events, overlaps 严重); annotator linked the date to sentence 3 (s3t :overlap date) and made date overlap 严重 differently (injury overlap 严重).
6.cause: Annotator anchored the date-entity to an earlier sentence's event and used a different chain instead of relating it to the reporting verb and the injury/serious events.
6.convention: A date-entity within a report is placed relative to the reporting event and contains/overlaps the events reported in it.

6.kind: Coreference chains differ: annotator linked 政府, 情况 and 启动 to earlier mentions with partial chains, and added unwanted links for 暴雨, city (港), 学校 and 停课.
6.cause: Annotator over-linked repeated words (暴雨, 学校, 停课, city) to earlier mentions that gold does not treat as coreferent, and missed some later mentions of 政府/情况/启动 in sentence 14.
6.convention: Coreference is annotated only for mentions that refer to the same specific entity/event; generic or re-described mentions are not linked.

7.kind: Organization named entity not annotated: 天文台 left as bare concept instead of organization with name
7.cause: Annotator did not apply the named-entity convention for institutions/organizations (name node with :name and :op1 string); kept the common noun as a concept
7.convention: Named entities such as institutions or organizations are represented as a typed entity (e.g. organization) with a :name node whose :op1 is the name string

7.kind: Coreference link to earlier mention of the organization lost (direction/target mismatch since the node is not a named organization)
7.cause: Consequence of the missing organization node; the coref was attached to the bare concept and does not match the gold entity chain
7.convention: Coreference chains link the entity nodes of repeated mentions; if the entity is typed/named, the chain is on that node

7.kind: Time range modeled as 'range' with :op1/:op2 instead of range-91 with :ARG1/:ARG2
7.cause: Annotator used a non-UMR 'range' concept with op roles rather than the UMR range-91 predicate with ARG1/ARG2
7.convention: A time span 'from X to Y' is expressed with range-91 whose :ARG1 and :ARG2 are the start and end

7.kind: Date components split incorrectly: weekday and dayperiod 星期四/晚 placed inside the start date-entity instead of a separate date-entity attached by :temporal to the range; start only has the time
7.cause: Annotator merged the day (Thursday evening) into the range start rather than treating it as a shared temporal modifier of the range
7.convention: A date/day that scopes the whole time range is a separate date-entity attached via :temporal to the range-91; the ARG1/ARG2 entities hold only the endpoint times

7.kind: Temporal modifier attached to the event as :temporal range instead of the range being the top temporal node with the date as its :temporal child (structure differs)
7.cause: Same structural mismatch in how the time expression hangs off the clause

7.kind: '有纪录以来' misanalyzed: 纪录 concept dropped; have-start-91 placed directly under 以来 with the year as ARG2, instead of 纪录 as op1 with ARG1-of have-start-91 whose ARG2 is the date. Year 1884 also reported extra
7.cause: Annotator collapsed the 'since there have been records' clause, omitting the noun 纪录 and making have-start-91 the argument of 以来
7.convention: Overt nouns in a phrase are kept as concepts; have-start-91 is attached as ARG1-of on the thing that begins (here 纪录), with ARG2 the start date

7.kind: Document-level temporal relations wrong: range linked to previous sentence's date by :overlap instead of document-creation-time :before; missing event :before have-start-91
7.cause: Annotator anchored the past time expression to a preceding sentence date rather than the document creation time, and did not annotate the temporal ordering between the recording event and the start of records
7.convention: A past-referring time expression is anchored to document-creation-time with :before; an event is :before the start (have-start-91) of a period it is compared against

8.kind: Station not annotated as a named 'station' entity; the name was split into a 火车站 concept with the city name attached by :mod
8.cause: The annotator treated 深圳火车站 as a common noun modified by the city 深圳 (:mod s8s) instead of as a named entity. It therefore reused the city node, and gave the station no name (深圳 火车站). The gold has a station with a two-token name.
8.convention: A proper-noun facility such as a station is annotated as a typed entity (station) with a :name of all its tokens. It does not get the city node as a modifier.

8.kind: Predicate 位于 (located at) not annotated as an event; the location is given as a :place local-region with a name. 罗湖 has the wrong type, and its name is extra.
8.cause: The annotator collapsed 位于 into a :place relation and typed 罗湖 as local-region. The gold keeps 位于-01 as a verb with ARG1 city-district. The missing event also removes its temporal relation (present-reference :overlap 位于).
8.convention: Verbal predicates such as 位于 are annotated as events with their own arguments. A district is typed city-district.

8.kind: Relative clause 由深圳开往多地的列车 not annotated as an event 开往-01. The annotator used :source and :goal on 列车 and linked the city as a source. The gold has 开往-01 with ARG1 city and ARG2 地. As a result, the :goal relation on 地 is extra.
8.cause: The annotator treated 开往 as a preposition-like source/goal construct and did not recognise it as a verb.
8.convention: A verb inside a relative clause modifying a noun is annotated as an event, with the head noun as ARG0-of or ARG1-of and the other participants as core arguments.

8.kind: 隔 arguments and roles wrong (ARG1-of with ARG2 河 versus gold ARG0-of with ARG1 河). Aspect is state in both, so the temporal and aspect differences come from elsewhere.
8.cause: The annotator labelled the city as the ARG1 (theme) of 隔 and the river as ARG2. In the gold the city is the ARG0 that separates and the river is the ARG1. The temporal anchor was also wrong: the annotator used document-creation-time :overlap where the gold uses present-reference :overlap for this stative modifier.
8.convention: A stative modifier clause describing a general or current situation is anchored to present-reference with :overlap, not to document-creation-time.

8.kind: 浸 (水浸) argument label wrong (ARG1 水 versus gold ARG2 水), aspect wrong (performance versus process), and the modal for 浸 is missing
8.cause: The annotator treated 水 as the ARG1 patient of 浸 and marked it performance. The gold uses ARG2 and process. The annotator also did not give 浸 its own full-affirmative modal and temporal relation.
8.convention: Process-type events get :aspect process. Each annotated event needs its own modal and temporal relation.

8.kind: The two consequences (困 and 停驶) are not marked as :cause-of the flooding event, and are instead listed as top-level and-operands. The gold has a nested and under 遭遇 with :cause-of.
8.cause: The annotator coordinated all four clauses flatly. It did not recognise that the trapped people and the suspended trains are results of the flooding. The gold has a flat and for the first two events and a nested and for the consequences.
8.convention: Clauses that are consequences of a preceding event are linked with :cause-of, and the consequences are grouped with a coordinating node under it.

8.kind: 困 aspect and arguments: aspect performance versus state. 站内 is typed local-region and appears as a bare reference to the station (ARG2 s8st), where the gold has 站内 as an entity with :part-of the station. 人 is typed person where the gold has 人.
8.cause: The annotator marked a resultant state as performance. It replaced the locative noun 站内 with the station itself. It also used the English concept person for 人, where the gold keeps the source-language lemma 人.
8.convention: Passive resultant states take :aspect state. Concepts for common nouns in Chinese documents use the source word, not an English one. Locative nouns such as 站内 remain entities with :part-of.

8.kind: 停驶 sense and aspect wrong (停驶-01 versus gold 停驶-00, and performance versus state)
8.cause: The annotator picked a roleset 停驶-01 that the gold treats as unlisted (-00). It also marked the future-looking, planned suspension as performance, where the gold has state.
8.convention: When the lexicon has no suitable frame, use -00. Planned or ongoing suspensions are annotated as state.

8.kind: Temporal structure wrong: the annotator anchored every event to document-creation-time :before, where the gold chains the events with :overlap relations (影响 overlap 遭遇 overlap 困 / 开往 / 浸, 开往 overlap 停驶)
8.cause: The annotator used a flat document-creation-time relation for each event and did not relate co-occurring events to each other.
8.convention: Events that occur at the same time as an earlier event in a narrative are linked by :overlap to that event, not each directly to document-creation-time.

8.kind: Coreference wrong: the annotator linked s8s (a station node) with s1s, and linked 暴雨 to the first 暴雨 only. The gold links the city 深圳 (s8c) to s1c. The chain with 当地 is partial, and 大雨 was included wrongly.
8.cause: The annotator attached the coreference to the wrong node (the station, via :mod) and handled the chains of 暴雨 and 大雨 inconsistently. The city mention should be the coreferent.
8.convention: Coreference follows the entity that is actually mentioned (the city here). Different words such as 大雨 and 暴雨 are not merged unless the text shows they refer to the same event.

9.kind: Locative 'existing in 当地' misanalyzed: 当地 made ARG2 of 录得 instead of the argument of exist-91 under 纪录
9.cause: The annotator read 在当地 as a participant of the recording event and did not see 'have a record in the local place' as an existential predicate. It therefore attached 当地 directly to 录得-01 as ARG2.
9.convention: Locative/existential phrases such as 'in place X, since there have been records' are annotated with exist-91 (ARG2-of on the thing that exists, ARG1 as the location). They are not attached as extra core arguments of the main event.

9.kind: Wrong predicate for 有纪录: have-start-91 used instead of exist-91 with 纪录 as ARG2-of
9.cause: The annotator interpreted 有纪录以来 as 'start of records' and invented a have-start-91 event, instead of treating 有 as existential and using exist-91.
9.convention: Chinese existential 有 is annotated as exist-91 (thing existing as ARG2-of, location as ARG1), not as have-start-91.

9.kind: 同样 annotated as a mod on have-degree-91; gold has no such node
9.cause: The annotator made the adverb 同样 into a concept (:mod) and attached it to have-degree-91. The gold does not represent it as a separate node, and the evaluator matched this node against the gold exist-91.
9.convention: Discourse-like adverbs such as 同样 ('likewise') are not always annotated as a :mod concept.

9.kind: 纪录 not placed under 以来 :op1 as the argument; the annotator inserted have-start-91 between them
9.cause: The annotator's incorrect event structure prevented the correct 以来 → 纪录 → exist-91 → 当地 chain.

9.kind: Temporal relation between document creation time and event date wrong, with the sentence's date chained to the previous sentence's date
9.cause: The annotator chained s9dt to the previous sentence's date with :overlap, instead of relating the date to document-creation-time with :before. The gold places a past date before the DCT.
9.convention: A past explicit date in a report is anchored to document-creation-time with :before. The date is not chained to an earlier date-entity.

9.kind: Event–date relation wrong: :overlap used instead of :contained
9.cause: The annotator used :overlap between the day date-entity and the event. The gold treats a day-long date as containing the event.
9.convention: When an event happens within a specified calendar day, the date-entity is :contained of the event, not :overlap.

9.kind: Missing temporal relation between the recording event and the existence of records (录得 :before exist-91)
9.cause: Because exist-91 was not created, the annotator could not give the ordering between the recording and the record's existence.

9.kind: Missing coreference: 当地 should corefer with the city mentioned earlier
9.cause: The annotator gave no same-entity link for 当地 ('the local area') to the city of the previous sentences.
9.convention: Anaphoric expressions like 当地 ('the local place') are linked with :same-entity to the previously mentioned place.

10.kind: 开始 treated as a separate event concept instead of aspectual/phase marker folded into 排洪
10.cause: Annotator made 开始-01 a full event with 排洪-01 as its argument, while the gold treats 开始 as an aspectual marker of 排洪 and keeps only 排洪-01 as the event. This led to extra event nodes and mismatched temporal and modal relations anchored to 开始.
10.convention: Aspectual/phase verbs such as 开始 (begin) are not annotated as separate events; the complement event is annotated and the time attaches to it.

10.kind: Wrong concept for 排洪 (not a sense-numbered verb event, and aspect process instead of activity)
10.cause: Annotator used 排洪-01 under 开始 with aspect process, and the first event ended up mismatched. Gold has aspect activity for the 排洪 event.
10.convention: Ongoing or begun unbounded activities are marked aspect activity, not process.

10.kind: Nominal modifier 排洪 in 排洪流量 not annotated as an event (排洪-01)
10.cause: Annotator wrote the modifier as a bare word 排洪 rather than 排洪-01, so the coref link to the other 排洪 events was not formed properly and the chain was split.
10.convention: Event-denoting words in modifier position are annotated as event concepts with sense IDs.

10.kind: Time expression 0时15分 not annotated as a separate peripheral date-entity event relevant to temporal ordering, with wrong relations
10.cause: The time was attached to 开始 and the temporal relations ordered with 表示 as :before, while the gold has the date-entity overlap 排洪 and is ordered after the 后 expression and before the 星期五 date.
10.convention: A date-entity with a time attached to an event is a peripheral temporal node that overlaps the event, and relations among date-entities and 后 are stated explicitly.

10.kind: Wrong temporal relations for the 星期五午夜 date-entity and 表示
10.cause: Annotator linked the date to the previous sentence's date (:overlap s3t) and used :overlap with 表示. The gold anchors the date after document creation time and has 表示 contained in it.
10.convention: A date-entity expressing a past day is :before document-creation-time, and the event stated within it is :contained in it, not merely overlapping.

10.kind: Wrong temporal relations for 加大 and the 后 expression
10.cause: Annotator ordered 加大 after 开始 with :before and did not relate the 后 expression to the 0时15分 date or to 排洪. The gold has 加大 contained in the 后 node, with the 后 expression after the time date-entity and overlapping the 排洪 event.
10.convention: A 后 (after) temporal expression is a node that contains the event, and is ordered relative to the reference time and event.

10.kind: Wrong modal structure for 排洪 / 开始
10.cause: Because 开始 was an event, the annotator gave city :full-affirmative to 开始 and an :unspecified link to 排洪. Gold gives city :full-affirmative directly to 排洪.
10.convention: Modal relations attach to the actual event, and an event asserted by the author is full-affirmative.

10.cause: The city chain omitted the 当地 mention from sentence 9 and linked to sentence 1 instead of sentence 8. The 排洪 events across sentences 10 and 11 were also not chained together properly.
10.convention: Repeated mentions of the same entity or event across sentences, including anaphoric descriptions like 当地, are chained.

11.kind: Organization name not typed as named entity (港府 left as bare concept instead of government-organization with name)
11.cause: Annotator treated the abbreviation 港府 as a plain concept instead of a named government organization. This also lost its coref link to the following sentence's government-organization and misaligned related units.
11.convention: Government bodies named by proper-name abbreviations are annotated as government-organization with a :name node whose op carries the name tokens.

11.kind: Wrong event sense or frame for 排洪, 提早 and 准备
11.cause: Annotator picked a different sense number or a non-predicate form. 排洪 was -01 but the gold coded 排洪 in the 预告 clause as a coreferent of the 排洪 in the final clause, 提早 was a non-event modifier, and 准备 got -01 rather than -02.
11.convention: Use the sense matching the PropBank roleset. Predicative modifiers such as 提早 are event concepts with -01 and their own args.

11.kind: 提早 45分钟 modelled as :manner with :extent rather than as a :temporal event with ARG2 quantity
11.cause: Annotator treated 提早 as a manner adverb and the time span as extent. The gold treats it as 提早-01 predicate with ARG2 temporal-quantity under :temporal.
11.convention: Adverbial 'earlier by N time' is a predicate (提早-01) attached by :temporal, with the amount as ARG2.

11.kind: Last clause structure wrong: 似乎/关系 coded as 关系-01 event with ARG1 浸 and mods rather than exist-91 with a negated 关系 and a conjunction of 水浸 and 排洪
11.check: a_event_concept; d_core_args_event; d_core_args_abstract; d_peripheral_entity; e_core_labels; c_polarity
11.cause: Annotator did not recognize 和 ... 没有 ... 关系 as a relational/existential structure, so it treated 关系 as a verb and put 似乎 as :mod. The gold uses exist-91 with ARG1 the conjunction (水浸 and 排洪) and ARG2 the 关系 noun. Polarity sits on exist-91.
11.convention: Existential or relational 有/没有 X关系 is annotated as exist-91 with ARG1 the possessor or related items and ARG2 the 关系 noun. Negation goes on exist-91 and 'A 和 B 没有关系' puts both in a conjunction.

11.kind: 水浸 participant role: 水 coded as ARG1 instead of ARG2
11.cause: Annotator used ARG1 for 水 in 浸-01, whereas the gold uses ARG2.
11.convention: Follow the PropBank roleset for 浸-01.

11.cause: Annotator gave 排洪 (in 预告) :aspect process while gold has activity, 指 performance while gold has state, 通知 had no aspect while gold has performance, 浸 performance while gold has process, and the final 关系 clause was coded state on 关系-01 rather than on exist-91.
11.convention: Reported-speech 指 is state, ongoing flooding 浸 is process, 排洪 is activity, and nominal event 通知 gets performance.

11.kind: Temporal relations anchored to document-creation-time rather than the date-entity and sequence in the sentence
11.cause: Annotator defaulted to document-creation-time :before for most events and missed the internal ordering. The gold chains 7日23时44分 to 预告, 排洪 and 提早, with 联络 and 准备 ordered and 表示 after 指. It also missed the :after link between the two date-entities and used :contained and :overlap differently for 预告.
11.convention: Events inside a reported clause are ordered relative to the nearest explicit time expression or governing event. Document-creation-time is used only for the sentence's main anchoring date-entity. Overlap between a date-entity and its event is encoded with :overlap or :contained as the gold marks.

11.cause: Annotator attached the modal to the author or 官员 incorrectly. It added :unspecified 排洪 under 预告 and a polarity-negative on 关系-01 in place of exist-91. It also dropped author :full-affirmative on 排洪 and coded 准备 as author-level rather than :unspecified under 联络, and 水浸 under 官员 instead of the author.
11.convention: Planned or prepared events are :unspecified under their governing event. Negated existential is :partial-negative from the source on exist-91. Events asserted by the author are author :full-affirmative, including 排洪 in the scheduled-event position.

11.cause: Annotator linked 排洪 in both clauses to sentence 10's 排洪 as separate chains, and the second 排洪 was not a separate event node. It also wrongly added 浸 coref with s1, and linked 当地 in sentence 9 only partially for the city chain.
11.convention: A repeated mention of the same event reuses one node (reentrancy) and is linked to the antecedent. Do not add coref for loosely related events.

11.kind: Subject of 接获 and 联络 correct in gold as government, but annotator used 官员
11.cause: Annotator made 官员 the agent of 接获 and 联络. The gold uses the government (港府) there.

12.kind: Missing reason/value structure: the annotator coordinated the clauses with 'and' instead of linking via have-reason-91 / have-value-91 (the probability clause explains why 应对 is difficult)
12.check: a_event_found, a_event_concept, d_core_args_abstract, d_core_args_event, d_peripheral_entity, e_core_labels
12.cause: The annotator read 即 and the following clauses as parallel text and used a top-level 'and' with op1/op2/op3, and did not recognize the causal/evaluative relation. It also treated 概率 as a predicate with :quant and :topic instead of have-value-91 with rate-entity-91 and :source.
12.convention: Explanatory/causal clause chains are represented with have-reason-91 and have-value-91 (with rate-entity-91 for percentages/probabilities), attached to the main event, not with a top-level 'and'.

12.kind: Missing 难-01 predicate and its structure (难 as the head with 应对 as ARG0, aspect state); 应对 was made a performance event with an ARG0 of the government, and 提早/大幅 were attached as manner/degree
12.check: a_event_found, c_aspect, d_core_args_event, d_peripheral_event, b_event_sense, e_core_labels, i_modal
12.cause: The annotator treated 难以 as a modifier or ignored it, and did not make 难 the predicate. It also did not use 提早-01 as an event, so 大幅 was a degree on a non-event instead of ARG2 of 提早-01.
12.convention: Modal/evaluative adjectives such as 难 are annotated as predicates (难-01) taking the event as an argument. Verbal modifiers like 提早 get a sense ID (-01) and are linked with ARG1-of, with their degree as ARG2.

12.kind: Named entity 港府 not typed as government-organization with a name node; it was left as a bare concept
12.cause: The annotator treated 港府 as a common noun instead of an organization name that needs a named-entity type. As a result the modal and coref nodes also point to the wrong node.
12.convention: Named organizations (including abbreviated names such as 港府) get a named-entity type (government-organization) with a :name node.

12.kind: 香港 linked to 雨势 with :place instead of :possessor
12.cause: The annotator interpreted 的 as a location relation, but the gold treats the possessive 的 as :possessor.
12.convention: A noun modified by a location noun with 的 takes :possessor.

12.kind: Wrong 雨势 structure and missing 如此: the second 雨势 (达到的雨势 with 如此) is not annotated; 雨量 is made ARG0 of 达到 and 雨势 is reused
12.cause: The annotator reused the same 雨势 node as the first mention instead of creating a new one, and it dropped 如此.
12.convention: A new mention with its own modifier (e.g. 如此雨势) is a separate node, and 如此 is annotated as :mod.

12.kind: Wrong role for 记载 and 过往: 记载 was a :manner and a bare concept without a sense, 雨量 was the topic, and 过往 was :mod instead of :temporal
12.cause: The annotator did not treat 记载 as a verbal event (记载-01 with an ARG1-of relation to 雨量, aspect performance), so it missed its temporal and modal relations.
12.convention: Deverbal nouns that denote events get a -01 sense and are annotated as events with aspect and document-level relations. Time words like 过往 take :temporal.

12.kind: Wrong aspect: habitual on 达到 and an extra aspect/value on the frequency rate; gold uses state for 难 and 应对, and has no ARG1 1 on the rate entity of 达到
12.cause: The annotator marked repeated events as habitual and put ARG1 1 and wrongly assigned ARG3 nodes, while the gold only has ARG3 for the frequency.
12.convention: Evaluative/stative predicates take aspect state, and rate-entity-91 for frequency lists only the needed arguments.

12.kind: Wrong document-level temporal relations: document-creation-time used instead of present-reference for the generic present, and missing relations between 形容 and 记载/提早/应对
12.cause: The annotator anchored generic or habitual events to the document-creation-time rather than present-reference, and did not produce event-to-event temporal links for the nested events.
12.convention: Generic or timeless statements are anchored with present-reference :overlap, and embedded events are ordered relative to the governing event.

12.kind: Wrong modal relations: the annotator used partial-negative on 应对 with the agent as the source and missed the author full-affirmative on 难, 记载 and 港府
12.cause: The annotator put the negation on 应对 with 港府 as the source, while the gold has 难-01 as the source of the partial-negative. This follows from the missing 难-01 predicate.
12.convention: Negative or difficulty predicates such as 难 are the modal source of partial-negative on the embedded event, and the author is the source of full-affirmative on the asserted events.

12.kind: Coreference chain errors: 港府 not linked to the earlier government entity in sentence 11, and spurious links to other 政府/当局/city mentions and to the 遇 events; 雨势 chain incomplete
12.cause: The annotator linked the wrong nodes (the city and other entities) and missed the 雨势 mention in later sentences, partly because the node types differ.
12.convention: Coreference is annotated only between mentions of the same entity or event, and the chain should include every mention of it.

13.kind: Quote structure missing: speech content not marked with :quote and top-level conjunction structure differs
13.cause: Annotator made 有-reason-91 the direct ARG1 of 说-01 instead of the coordinated 'and' of the quoted clauses, and didn't use :quote
13.convention: The content of a reported speech event is the ARG1 (a coordination of the stated clauses) and the root 说 is linked back with :quote; connective 所以 is expressed as have-reason-91 attached to the conjunct as ARG2-of, not as a wrapper above the whole quote

13.kind: Reason structure inverted/misnested: have-reason-91 placed as parent with 预告 as ARG1 and the whole 'and' as ARG2; gold nests reason chain (and → ARG2-of have-reason-91 → 低 → ARG2-of have-reason-91 → 预告)
13.cause: Misreading of 所以 chain: 'because X, so Y' was flattened into one have-reason-91 with all clauses as one cause
13.convention: For 所以/因此 causal chains, use have-reason-91 as ARG2-of on the cause, with ARG1 the consequence, nested per clause; the consequence of the immediately preceding clause only

13.kind: Wrong role for 大幅/提早 and 应对: annotated as :manner (and degree on 提早) instead of 提早-01 as ARG1-of with ARG2 大幅, and 应对 as :example
13.cause: 提早 treated as a non-predicate manner concept with degree; the 如…般 comparison to a typhoon response not recognised as an example
13.convention: Predicative adverbials like 提早 get a verb sense (-01) and attach as ARG1-of to the event with their extent as ARG2; 如…般 exemplifications use :example

13.kind: Wrong participant / spurious temporal: 之前 treated as a temporal argument of 应对 and 应对 annotated with 台风 as ARG1 lacking natural-disaster; 预告 lacks ARG1 (大雨)
13.cause: 之前 (before) attached as :temporal concept with ARG0 reused; the typhoon name not typed as natural-disaster; ARG1 of 预告 (the rain) omitted
13.convention: Named typhoons are typed natural-disaster with name op1 台风 op2 苏拉 (whole name including generic head); 之前 is not a separate concept when modifying 的 clause; reentrant arguments should be filled

13.kind: Typhoon name tokens wrong: only 苏拉 in the name, concept 台风 used as the head
13.cause: Annotator split 台风 as the concept and kept only 苏拉 as the name
13.convention: Name includes all tokens of the name phrase, e.g. 台风 苏拉, with the concept being a type like natural-disaster

13.kind: Rain NP modeled wrongly: 大雨 with 这场 not captured; annotator used 雨 with 这 and 场 unit, and 雨势 not possessed by 大雨; topic role inserted
13.cause: Split 这场大雨 into 这, 场, 雨 instead of keeping the lexical units 大雨 and 这场; used :topic and :unit
13.convention: Follow the gold tokenization/lexical concepts (大雨 as one concept, 这场 as a mod); 雨势 is related to the rain with :possessor; no :unit for classifiers

13.kind: Missing 同事 as colleague relation and missing 正如 as :mod of 提及; annotator made 同事 plain and omitted 正如
13.cause: Did not recognise 同事 as a relational noun of the speaker (have-rel-role-92) and dropped the discourse marker 正如
13.convention: Relational nouns like 同事 get have-rel-role-92 with ARG2-of linking to the referent; 正如 'as' is kept as :mod on the verb

13.kind: 预测程度 modeled as 预测-01 event, instead of 可预测 as a modifier of 程度 with possessor
13.cause: Segmented 可 预测 and made 预测-01 a predicate with an event aspect, producing extra temporal and modal relations
13.convention: Adjectival 可预测 stays a single (non-event) modifier concept; 程度 takes :possessor

13.kind: Temporal relations anchored to document-creation-time instead of the 说 event / present-reference; missing ordering among 提及, 提早, 应对
13.cause: Annotator defaulted all events to DCT :before; quoted-speech events should be anchored to the speech event, and habitual state to present-reference
13.convention: Events inside reported speech are anchored to the speech event (overlap for current states); generic/habitual events use present-reference :overlap; earlier mentions are ordered :before the later event

13.kind: Modal annotation uses first-person plural as the source and neutral-affirmative on 预测; gold uses the speaker 陈国基 as the modal source
13.cause: Used s13p (我们) as modal source instead of the quoted speaker
13.convention: Events inside a quotation hang under the speaker (the ARG0 of the speech verb)

13.kind: Coreference mismatch: rain not linked to 暴雨 of sentence 8; spurious chains for 雨势, 遇-01, and organization
13.cause: Linked 雨势 and 遇 with earlier similar mentions, missed the identity of 大雨 with the earlier 暴雨
13.convention: Coreference follows identity of the referent: the same rain event (大雨/暴雨) links; separate occurrences of similar predicates are not automatically same-event

14.kind: Wrong clause structure: but-91 scope and sentence-level coordination
14.cause: The annotator made the whole first sentence one flat coordination. It put but-91 over (宣布 and 要求) and put (呼吁 and 发) under ARG2. The gold keeps 宣布 as its own conjunct, makes but-91 contrast 要求 (停课) with 呼吁, and treats 发 as a separate conjunct. The gold also groups the two sentences as snt1 and snt2.
14.convention: Each sentence is its own coordination. but-91 links only the two directly contrasted events, and the other clauses stay coordinated beside it.

14.kind: 要求 with 停课: wrong sense (要求-02 vs 要求-01) and wrong argument structure (school as ARG1, 停课 as ARG2; aspect process vs performance)
14.cause: The annotator used the 'require something of someone' frame. The gold uses 要求-01, with the event as ARG1 and the school as ARG0 of 停课-01.
14.convention: A directive verb whose complement is an event takes that event as ARG1. The complement's own agent is that event's ARG0. Completed or declared events get performance aspect.

14.kind: Event nouns or verbs left as bare concepts without a sense (工作, 启动)
14.cause: The annotator did not assign PropBank-style senses to 工作 (gold 工作-01) or to the later 启动 (gold 启动-01). It also gave 工作 a role and aspect that differ from the gold. The gold gives the 安排 object 工作-01 process, and 工作-01 habitual under the 地点.
14.convention: Eventive words are annotated as sense-numbered events with aspect, even inside noun phrases.

14.kind: 参考/安排 relation and labels: 安排 as :purpose instead of ARG2; 弹性 as :manner instead of :mod; extra ARG0 and aspect differences
14.cause: The annotator treated 安排 as a purpose adjunct and 弹性 as a manner. The gold takes 安排 as a core argument (ARG2) of 参考 and 弹性 as a plain modifier. The annotator also gave 参考 process aspect where the gold has performance.
14.convention: The complement event of a 参考-type verb is a core argument. 弹性 modifying an event noun is :mod.

14.kind: Extra modifier concepts that the gold drops: 只, 又, 才
14.cause: The annotator turned focus and adverbial particles (只, 又, 才) into :mod nodes. The gold omits these or absorbs them elsewhere.
14.convention: Focus or discourse adverbs such as 只, 又 and 才 are generally not annotated as separate concepts.

14.kind: 指引 content clause: 指引 modelled as ARG0-of 指-02 with an extra 指-02 event, instead of 指引 ARG1-of identity-91 whose ARG1 is 要求-02
14.check: a_event_found, d_core_args_abstract, d_core_args_event, d_peripheral_event, a_event_concept, c_aspect
14.cause: The annotator read 指 as a speech event and attached it to 指引. The gold treats the guideline as identical to the content 要求. The annotator also put ARG0 on 要求, gave it aspect performance (gold state), and wrongly kept 才 as a mod.
14.convention: A noun and its appositive or content clause are linked with identity-91, with no extra reporting-verb event.

14.kind: Exception phrase: except-01 with ARG2 instead of :subtraction
14.cause: The annotator used the English-style except-01 predicate. The gold uses the :subtraction role.
14.convention: 'X 外的 Y' (Y apart from X) is annotated with :subtraction on the whole, not with except-01.

14.kind: 返回 destination and 工作 location: ARG4 vs ARG1 for 地点, and 工作 as :mod instead of 地点 :place-of 工作-01
14.cause: The annotator used ARG4 and put the returning person as ARG1. The gold makes 地点 the ARG1 of 返回-01 and attaches 工作-01 via :place-of.
14.convention: The place noun is the core argument of 返回. A modifying verbal noun is linked to it with :place-of, not :mod.

14.kind: 解释 argument and duplicate 指引: identity-91 as ARG1 with a duplicated 指引 node (plus a coref link) instead of ARG3 with the reentrant 指引; aspect performance vs state
14.cause: The annotator re-introduced 指引 as a new node, which also caused an extra coref chain. It chose the ARG1 frame of 解释 instead of ARG3. It gave 解释 and 指 performance aspect, where the gold has state.
14.convention: Re-mentions in the same sentence are reentrant variables, not new nodes. Reporting or explaining predicates that state a stance are annotated as state.

14.kind: 回应 negation clause: have-reason-91 placed as ARG1 of 回应 instead of ARG2 umr-unknown with ARG2-of have-reason-91; light verb 作出 missing; polarity put on 要求; 启动 not a full event
14.check: d_core_args_event, d_core_args_abstract, c_polarity, d_peripheral_event, b_event_sense, a_event_concept, c_aspect
14.cause: The annotator skipped the light verb 作出 and negated 要求 directly. It tried to place 启动 as a temporal under an event without ARG0 and without a sense, and it made 一并 a mod. The gold makes 作出-01 the negated event with ARG1 要求-02, :temporal 启动-01 (ARG0 当局), and :manner 一并.
14.convention: Light-verb constructions such as 作出要求 keep the light verb as the event and put the noun in ARG1. The 'why' of an unanswered question is umr-unknown with ARG2-of have-reason-91, and 回应 takes it as ARG2.

14.kind: Time expression: nesting of date-entity and 许 inverted (许 over date-entity vs date-entity with :time 许 over 07h00m)
14.cause: The annotator wrapped the date-entity inside 许 (about). The gold keeps the date-entity on top with :time 许 whose op1 is the clock time.
14.convention: Approximation markers like 许 attach inside the :time slot of the date-entity.

14.kind: Document-level temporal anchoring wrong: events tied to DCT with :before, wrong relation between the two times, and wrong ordering between 宣布 and its content
14.cause: The annotator linked many events (要求, 呼吁, 解释, 指, 回应) directly to DCT with :before. It also made 宣布 overlap the 5:30 date-entity (gold :contained) and linked the 5:30 date-entity to the previous sentence's date. The gold chains events within the sentence. It has 宣布 :after 启动 and the 7:00 time containing 发. The annotator gave 宣布 :overlap 启动 (gold: :after), and gave the date-entity before 7:00 where the gold has :after. The gold's own :after between the two times looks reversed, since 5:30 precedes 7:00.
14.convention: Events in a sentence are chained to each other with :overlap, :after or :before. DCT anchors only the first event or time. A date-entity contains the events that happen in it.

14.kind: Temporal ordering of 发, 要求, 返回, 作出, 回应 and 启动 wrong or missing
14.cause: The annotator ordered 发 as overlapping the 要求 and its sub-events, and as :after 返回. The gold has 要求 overlap 返回 and 作出 overlap 要求. It gave 回应 overlap 作出 without the gold's 回应 :before 启动, and omitted 参考/安排 and 要求/工作 overlaps in the gold form.
14.convention: Events embedded in a reported or required content overlap with their governing event. Events that are only hypothetically required are not ordered after the governing event.

14.kind: Modal annotation: missing full-affirmative on identity-91, 工作, 启动; wrong strength on 要求-02 (should be under 作出 as unspecified; gold partial-negative differs); embedded events set to author-full-affirmative or full-negative instead of governed :unspecified
14.cause: The annotator attached embedded events to the author with full-affirmative. It put full-negative on the negated 要求 instead of a negated 作出. It also put the 作出 negation on the wrong node and missed several events.
14.convention: Events in a directive's complement (停课, 安排, 返回) hang off the directive event as :unspecified. Negated light-verb events get full-negative on the light verb. Every sense-numbered event needs a modal node.

14.kind: Extra modal links: 当局 or 回应 :unspecified 要求; 行之有效 anchored on 当局 vs author
14.cause: The annotator added modal links for 当局 and for 回应 → 要求. The gold does not annotate 当局 as an author-level modal head, and anchors the negated 作出 differently. For 行之有效 the gold and the listing disagree.
14.convention: Only events get modal nodes. Participants do not get author-level modal links.

15.kind: Wrong concept for 下暴雨: annotated 降-03 with ARG1 暴雨 instead of 下-05 with ARG0 暴雨 and aspect performance
15.cause: Annotator chose a different lexical item and frame for the rain event, giving the rainstorm the wrong core role and omitting the aspect.
15.convention: Use the verb as it appears in the text (下) with its PropBank frame; the rainstorm is ARG0 of 下-05; every eventive predicate gets an aspect.

15.kind: First-person 我 not represented as a person entity with refer-person 1st and refer-number singular; replaced by a coreference to the speaker (s15p), so 认为 ARG0 is wrong and refer attributes are missing
15.cause: Annotator reused the speaker node via reentrancy for the pronoun 我 instead of creating a new person node with 1st-person attributes.
15.convention: Pronouns are annotated as person with refer-person and refer-number; they are not collapsed into a named entity, even when they corefer.

15.kind: Structure of the 必要 clause: the annotator made have-reason-91 the ARG1 of 认为 with 必要 inside it; gold has 必要-01 as ARG1 of 认为 with have-reason-91 as an ARG1-of on 必要. The 告知 event is ARG0 of 必要 in the gold, not ARG1
15.cause: Annotator treated 所以 as a top-level reason relation and made 告知 the argument ARG1 of 必要, rather than attaching reason as inverse on the clause and using ARG0 for the subject.
15.convention: Reason clauses (所以/因为) are expressed with ARG1-of have-reason-91 on the effect predicate; the clausal subject of 必要 is ARG0.

15.kind: Extra manner structure and extra nodes in the 告知 event: 发信 was annotated as a manner event (发-01 with ARG1 信) and a separate aspect, whereas gold only has instrument 系统 on 告知
15.check: a_entity_found; a_entity_concept; d_peripheral_event; c_aspect; i_modal; h_temporal
15.cause: Annotator over-analysed 用…发信告知 as a serial verb construction and added a manner event, whose pronoun/type got mismatched, creating extra modal and temporal relations.
15.convention: In 用X V1 V2 serial constructions, X is an instrument of the main event; the light/means verb is not added as a separate manner event.

15.kind: Extra 都 as :mod on 知道
15.cause: Annotator reified the adverb 都 as a mod, though the gold leaves it out.
15.convention: Quantificational adverbs like 都 are not annotated as :mod.

15.kind: Modifier structure: 紧急 attached as sibling :mod of 系统 rather than as :mod of 短讯; 如此 attached as :mod of 情况 rather than as :degree of 明显
15.cause: Annotator flattened the modifiers instead of following the scope of the modification.
15.convention: Modifiers are attached to the head they modify (紧急 modifies 短讯; degree adverbs such as 如此 are :degree of the adjective).

15.kind: Compound title 副司长 split into 司长 with mod 副 instead of a single concept 副司长
15.cause: Annotator decomposed a lexicalized compound title.
15.convention: Lexicalized compounds are kept as a single concept.

15.kind: Aspect and polarity placement: extra aspect on the manner 使用 and the 搭建/使用 events; missing performance aspect on the gold 告知; extra state aspect on 认为
15.cause: Annotator assigned aspects inconsistently to the embedded events and the attitude predicate.
15.convention: Aspect values depend on the event type: embedded events within the manner/quantity phrase carry no aspect; 认为 as the state-type attitude is not given a separate aspect when ...

15.kind: Temporal relations: annotator anchored nearly every event to the document-creation-time (before), whereas gold used relations among events (使用 after 说, 暴雨 contained 使用, 搭建 after 暴雨, 说 overlap 认为, 认为 overlap 知道/必要); also missing DCT before manner 使用 and missing 搭建 after 暴雨
15.cause: Annotator defaulted to DCT-before for past or reported events instead of relating them to embedded events in the sentence and the reporting event.
15.convention: Events in a reported speech are related to the reporting verb (overlap) rather than to the DCT; events with explicit time expressions are related to those.

15.kind: Modal structure: the annotator used s15p (the person) as source for 认为 and its complements, whereas gold uses the speaker's person node as source and an author link to 下-05 and 告知; the annotator has extra unspecified relations and wrongly puts 必要 → 告知 as unspecified
15.cause: Annotator selected the wrong modal sources (the 认为 event instead of the person) and layered unspecified relations on a nested event.
15.convention: The modal source of a complement is the person (the 认为 holder), and events asserted by the author as fact get author :full-affirmative.

15.kind: Coreference: the annotator linked the rainstorm mentions across sentences (the 暴雨 time and the 暴雨 argument) and the organization, whereas gold has no such chains here
15.cause: Annotator over-linked repeated mentions, treating the rainstorm event as a single entity and linking the government organization with a previous mention.
15.convention: Coreference is only annotated when mentions are identical referents; generic/event mentions with different roles are not necessarily coreferent.
